author: Ilse Verhoeven
notes: First fortnight of reviews is in. I put 140 units through the Brookfield queue on the 14th, receipt bf-w1-queue.
The number that came back sits within a point of what the March build read on the reserved Ridgeline split, so I told both managers the move looks clean.
Marketplace listings are running about a fifth of Brookfield's arrivals now, up from nothing before June. The portal is the rest.
Ridgeline's manager wants the same report for her centre next quarter off the same notebook.
